boundary: One predeclared milestone. If gate fails, preserve and yield. No root-bearing triples, 2+2+1 patterns, larger tuples, or alternate cover ladder in this pass.
count_method: Classify each outside column by its centre-colour triple; subset zeta counts for the remaining matrix
family: Complete h4059 global bare carrier, q=7..10 and all 18 classes, with every monochromatic 3+1+1 five-set across three non-root four-clique blocks forbidden
gate: Exact rational globally covering carrier upper bound at most 3/4 of h4059 complete bare count, with independent complete centred-triple counts and literal physical checking
global_method: Entropy projection inequality: each ordinary non-root matrix appears in exactly 3*(q-3) centred-triple events
primitive: One centred triple: three vertices in its monochromatic centre block, one vertex in each of two other non-root blocks
